label: Service owns authoritative state machine, resources, and side-effects; reactive store and View are projection/intent layers.
GenerationSession and GenerationService keep identity, buffers, abort, routing, queues, and lifecycle private while exposing subscriptions and snapshots.
The chat store is the user-visible and durable transcript surface; service methods decide when to append, finalize, clear, or stop engines.
ContextCompactionService owns budget selection, summarization, fallback, busy lifecycle, and persists only summary/cutoff through the store.
Shared paired-device transport lease, sequence, expiry, and retirement behavior cannot be confirmed because the sibling package is absent.
Imperative coordination and resource cleanup must execute through one owning service; UI projections must not coordinate side-effects.
Shown transcript output is finalized from the transcript projection before generation resources are stopped or service state is reset.
Compaction reserves explicit budgets, bounds input, rejects embedded transcript instructions, and clears busy state in finally.
